confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on crowd-sourced, modeled city figures (Citycost Dambulla, Whereandwhen, Combien-coute, Numbeo Weligama) that differ by source and by venue type; tourist-area restaurants near the cave temple and Sigiriya may run above these. Cappuccino and beer are the most consistent across sources. Cocktail and wine_glass are not directly sourced; they use an assumed multiple of the beer anchor (about 2.5x for cocktail, about 2x for wine), and wine is especially uncertain because alcohol availability and licensing in Dambulla are limited. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation prices were searched and no live listings were checked. FX: the RBA exchange-rates page listed 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, but the RBA overview showed 0.6955 as at 15 October, so the 16 October value may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Dambulla-specific aggregated restaurant and drink prices where available, cross-checked against national Sri Lanka averages and Sri Lankan tourism towns (Sigiriya, Matale, Kandy). Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor using a local price relationship, as direct data was weak. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for budget and mid-range tourist accommodation in a Sri Lankan cultural-tourism town.
